overview_description.description: Supertone, the catalyst for creative voice, is a top-notch artificial intelligence (AI) audio company with a vision to create a landscape where anyone can speak and be heard in the voice they want. Utilizing cutting-edge voice AI technology specializing in voice separation and synthesis, Supertone pushes the boundaries of creativity, offering an infinite possibility of diverse, expressive voices across various content and entertainment sectors.

about_short_description.short_description: Supertone is a top-notch AI audio company with a vision to create a landscape where anyone can speak and be heard in the voice they want.

product.name: Supertone API
product.description: An API providing natural and expressive text-to-speech synthesis with emotional and multilingual voice capabilities.

product.name: Supertone Play
product.description: A text-to-speech service allowing users to generate speech in various character voices and clone their own voice for multilingual use without sign-up or payment.

product.name: Supertone Clear
product.description: An audio plug-in for real-time noise reduction, de-reverb, and voice separation to enhance voice clarity in recordings and streams.

product.name: Supertone Shift
product.description: A real-time AI voice changer software that transforms a user's voice into various styles with low latency and customizable parameters.

product.name: Supertone Air
product.description: An audio plug-in for matching reverb and EQ characteristics of dialogue recordings to unify acoustic environments in post-production.
